page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. A chapter heading stands above the second paragraph, and the body text runs to the foot. A small woodcut emblem sits at the left of the second paragraph's first line. Show-through and the edge of the neighbouring page appear at the right edge. No margin notes, no notes below the text.

main_text.p: Quid intereft inter Caussam,Principium,& Antecedens? Locus eft infignis apud Poly-bium lib.III, in quo fapienter admonet,per-magni omnibus in vitæ partibus intereffe, notum effe difcrimen inter Caussam & Principium. Sed illa confideratio ad actiones,veluti ad rei militaris officia, de quibus eo loco agebat,tota pertinet. Caussas igitur ait effe, in rebus omnibus primas. principia vero vltima caussarum. Denique caussas effe,quę deliberationem antecedunt,vt confilia & ratio-cinationes. Principia vero idem appellat primas hominum actiones in rebus,quæ decreta & deliberatæ funt. Sed Antecedentium & Con-sequétium ratio nihil ad hoc genus pertinet, quod totum confilij eft, cum illa fint neces-sitatis.
main_text.head: De Adiunctis. CAP. XIIII.
main_text.p: AAE funt Adiuncta? Quæ probabiliter communi hominum opinione rei attribuuntur. Græci τὰ κοινῶς συμ-βεβηκότα, τὰ ὡς ἐπὶ τὸ πολύ [?], τὰ μὴ ἀεὶ ἐ-πόμενα nominant: Id eft plerunque & cómuniter contingentia: veluti, Adiunctum eft vi-ris,vt fint barbati: quamuis id non omnibus contingat. page.notes: The woodcut emblem beside the first line of the second paragraph is decorative and is not transcribed. The Greek phrase "ὡς ἐπὶ τὸ πολύ" is marked [?] because the scan is hard to read. The running head is set with a space ("DIALECTIC AE") and is given as DIALECTICAE. The heading is set in italic and capitals and is given as one head. The catchword "te" is at the foot right. The printed hyphens at line ends are kept in "Poly-bium", "per-magni", "Con-sequétium", "ratio-cinationes" and "neces-sitatis".
